name: apiary_bonus_to_fliers
description: The Beekeeper's Apiary (design 3.4, contract-m6 3): it prefers winged creeps, as the Hawk Roost does, and its bolts deal 50% more to them (air_bonus_pm): 18 to a Gourdling, 27 to a Duskmoth; a Royal Apiary, whose own bonus is 135% since M8's fork pass, 24 and 56.4 (34 and 51 before).

steps.assert: apiary.air and apiary.aim == 1 and apiary.air_bonus_pm == 500 and apiary.range_mm == 4200
steps.msg: an Apiary: air, prefers winged, +50% to fliers
it picks the Duskmoth over the Gourdling further along
a Royal Apiary's 24 is 56.4 to a flier
